observations: Front view shows a silver Maxi standing cooker with 5 control knobs and two buttons.
Top view shows 3 gas burners and 1 electric hotplate.
The electric hotplate is heavily rusted and shows signs of significant wear or exposure.
Rear view shows a standard orange gas hose and a power cord with a UK-style plug.
The brand 'MAXI' is printed on the top right of the front panel.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the brand; dimensions are typical for this style but unmeasured.
photo 1 shows heavy rust/corrosion on the electric hotplate and staining around burners.

risks.risk: Gas burners or oven may not ignite or may have leaks.
risks.proof: Video of all burners and the oven burner lit and staying lit.

risks.risk: Electric hotplate may be non-functional due to visible corrosion.
risks.proof: Video of the hotplate heating up (glowing or boiling water).

risks.risk: Oven interior may be damaged, dirty, or missing racks.
risks.proof: Photo of the oven interior with the door open.

proof_requests: Video of all three gas burners and the oven burner lit.
Video showing the electric hotplate heating up.
Photo of the inside of the oven.
Clear photo of the technical label on the back to confirm the model.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Maxi 3+1 standing cooker. Due to the heavy rust on the hotplate and lack of functional proof, it is priced as a non-working unit for parts or repair.
